ctx.x: What other pianists were interesting that you had to watch, were tricky like that, that you might remember?
Well, Don Ewell, that was my boy, me and him worked together for 12 years. He was tricky, he changed all right.

items.title: Don Ewell Interview, 1960-12-01
items.q: Oh, yeah, Ed Garland. Yes. Oh, I had a lot of enjoyment playing with that section.
